Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Presentation evidence

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

run.py reuses the bounded online runner and actual production menu inputs. It opens two headed Chrome processes with rendering enabled and without software-GL fallback flags, records the actual WebGL renderer/viewport/DPR, captures play and settings screenshots and uses Puppeteer's real page recorder with installed FFmpeg. The WebM recorder outputs 30 FPS; this is not a measurement of game FPS. The complete state, acknowledgement and typed teardown checks still run.

The page initializer inserts a pass-through WebAudio analyser in the real destination graph. It records output RMS and context state; it does not inject test audio. Nonzero signal proves rendered audio output, not a human hearing or usability judgment. The sound samples are original deterministic synthesis from make_audio.py, with provenance beside the generated assets.

Shell
nix develop --command python3 -B tests/replay_dockyard/presentation/run.py \
  --production-ui --ticks 6000 \
  --export-record /ABS/ordinary-export/report.json \
  --service-record /ABS/prepared-service/report.json \
  --out /ABS/NEW-render-case --godot /ABS/Godot

The caller-selected 6,000-tick/360-second capture bounds do not change the shared runner's shorter functional defaults. No backend, model, controller, round rule or collision-profile change is needed for audio/particles. Confirmed boost and delivery/latch cues populate a 16-entry local presentation FIFO; the view consumes each sequence once. The latch thud/score chime is not a claim of a newly exposed Native collision-contact stream.

serve.py starts a private, local-only interactive server from an actual accepted production export and binds it to the accepted cohort. The existing room service issues authenticated expiring relay credentials to the ordinary browser. Private keys, databases, TURN configuration and browser profiles must not be published. It emits INTERACTIVE_ONLY_NO_GAME_VERDICT, never a human-gameplay PASS. Use distinct browser profiles for separate memberships; the URL is local to the reference machine. Real two-person co-op feedback remains separate and required.

Actual presentation captures do not qualify the final hardware time/memory/load contract. Q1 measures those boundaries on the final frozen candidate, retaining all raw samples, failures and outliers.
